title: Claim
description: An enforcement primitive asserting an actor's presence and requesting coordination in a named zone.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this claim.

zone.description: Target zone path. Same addressing model as the advisory layer.

mode.description: hard: blocks conflicting operations. soft: warns but does not block.

expires_at_unix.description: Expiry timestamp. Mandatory for remote-origin claims.

requested_paths.description: Specific paths within the zone (advisory precision hint).

negotiation_note.description: Message to conflicting actors during contention.

override_actor_id.description: Actor who overrode this claim (populated when state is 'overridden').

override_reason.description: Reason for override (populated when state is 'overridden').
